heading: Today
text: Morning clouds, and early showers in NH, giving with to periods of sunshine.  A few localized afternoon showers or a thunderstorm, especially later in the day.  Cooler.  Highs ranging through the 70s, a few low 80s south.  Winds light, becoming northwest near 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: A localized evening shower of thunderstorm north, then gradually clearing and some areas of dense fog developing.  Lows in the 50s, near 50 in the cool spots.  Winds northwest near 10 mph, diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Friday
text: Areas of dense valley fog burning off to sunshine, mixed with a few clouds.  Another fairly cool day.  Highs from 70 to 80 north to south.  Winds light, becoming northwest, then more northerly near 10 mph.
